evidence_kind: complete symbolic source-derived contract; actual file lengths/configuration/traffic/outputs remain unknown

symbols.T: swappable CPU optimizer subgroups in this rank, successful non-overflow steady-state step
symbols.N_i: FP32 subgroup allocated elements including ZeRO partition padding; useful n_i<=N_i
symbols.p: AIO intra_op_parallelism, positive accepted config unknown
symbols.L_i: 4*a*ceil(N_i/a) expected aligned file bytes per FP32 parameter/momentum/variance
symbols.Q_i: sum elements in aligned gradient segments that pass max(1MiB,block_size) threshold
symbols.B: swap_config.buffer_count, configured value unknown; default4 is not validated pipelined capacity
symbols.H: actual legally available CPU memory budget, unknown

scalar_step_metadata: CPU scalar increment, no tensor state swap file

source_requested_NVMe_bytes.aligned_fully_swapped_special_case: if Q_i=N_i and L_i=4*N_i, total32*sum N_i; read16*sum N_i/write16*sum N_i
source_requested_NVMe_bytes.condition: mature Adam states, successful I/O, files matching expected shapes; first use, overflow, small retained tails, actual file sizes accounted separately

CPU_logical_operands_not_physical_DDR.gradient_unscale_clip: 8*sum N_i read+write, plus scalar/global norm prerequisites
CPU_logical_operands_not_physical_DDR.fp32_to_fp16_publication: 6*sum N_i if that branch executes; destination CPU/GPU/NVMe location unspecified
CPU_logical_operands_not_physical_DDR.small_gradient_tail_copy: 8*sum (N_i-Q_i) logical read+write when all missing segments resident; dtype/location/other staging costs additional

persistent_storage.pinned_swap_pool: B*L_max; allocated/zeroed/pinned at constructor, retained across pool slot free
persistent_storage.mature_NVMe_states: 3*sum L_i + 4*sum Q_i expected currently live files plus filesystem metadata
persistent_storage.all_CPU_residency_ordinary: 12*sum N_i state bytes + gradient residency up to4*sum N_i + lowprecision2*sum N_i if present + model/runtime/queues/metadata; fit needs H, no free assumption
persistent_storage.pipeline_pool_slots: steady mature tile with gradients reserves4 slots; read-ahead two tiles requires at least8; when previous write retains4 allocated slots while current4+next4 coexist, both-pipeline internal phase may require12; this is source-order conditional capacity bound, no allocation/run performed
